jobs.prompt: Write tests/go-ignoretests.test.mjs (node:test, node:assert/strict, plain ESM, first line "// SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0", second line "import './_isolate-config.mjs';"), copying the fixture, lead, worker, workers and reply helpers and the imports you need from tests/leads-run.test.mjs (read it for the exact pattern). Scenario: in the fixture repo, add a tracked file docs/notes.md and a tracked test file tests/notes.test.mjs whose text mentions "docs/notes.md", and commit them (the fixture's git commit step must run after you write them). A lead (type lead) plans one child worker whose outputs are ["docs/notes.md"] and whose scope is docs/. Test 1: runManifest with that lead completes (state.jobs[0].status is "complete" and state.jobs[0].childRun is set) instead of failing with "Uncovered test references"; read the child run state with readState and assert its worker job has "tests/notes.test.mjs" in ignoreTests of the saved manifest or that its prompt contains the line "ignoreTests: tests/notes.test.mjs". Test 2: validateProject-style refusal still applies to a manifest a person writes: runManifest on a plain manifest with one worker whose outputs are ["docs/notes.md"] (no ignoreTests, not a lead) rejects, or returns a failed state, with an error matching /Uncovered test references/. Keep it about 60 lines. Use only names exported by the files you read.
